rules.description: Applicant must already be claiming Universal Credit
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be claiming Universal Credit to apply for the limited capability element. Apply for Universal Credit first.

rules.description: Applicant must have a health condition or disability that affects ability to work
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have a health condition or disability that limits your capability for work

rules.description: Applicant must provide medical evidence such as a fit note
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide a fit note or other medical evidence from your GP or healthcare professional

rules.description: Applicant must be resident in Great Britain or Northern Ireland
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for UK residents only

rules.description: Applicant must not already be receiving the LCWRA element
rules.reason_if_failed: You are already receiving the limited capability for work and work-related activity element

rules.description: If terminal illness, different process applies
rules.reason_if_failed: You should use the Special Rules for Terminal Illness process for faster support

explanation_template: LCWRA element eligibility: {outcome}. If eligible, you will need to complete a Work Capability Assessment.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is terminally ill with prognosis of 12 months or less
edge_cases.action: Fast-track under Special Rules for Terminal Illness (SRTI). No claimant commitment or assessment required. Automatic LCWRA award.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has severe mental health condition requiring specialist assessment
edge_cases.action: Arrange assessment with mental health specialist. Extended assessment time may be needed. Consider home assessment.
Assessment must consider worst-case scenarios and cumulative effects. Diary evidence may be requested.

edge_cases.description: Applicant already receives PIP with enhanced daily living component
edge_cases.action: May be eligible for automatic LCWRA determination without full WCA. DWP will review PIP evidence.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is in full-time education with pre-existing LCWRA assessment
edge_cases.action: Must have been assessed as having limited capability BEFORE starting course. Verify assessment date and course start date.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is experiencing or fleeing domestic abuse
edge_cases.action: Apply safeguarding measures. Assessment may need alternative location. Consider temporary easements on claimant commitment.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a pending mandatory reconsideration or appeal
edge_cases.action: Do not submit new application. Existing appeal must be resolved first. Signpost to mandatory reconsideration process.

edge_cases.description: Applicant started health-related UC or ESA claim before 3 April 2017
edge_cases.action: Lower LCWRA element amount applies (£158.76 instead of £423.27). Legacy rules apply.
